# Northcoast Classic Auto Restoration (concept by Kerblabs)

> Classic car restoration shop in Willoughby, Ohio with over 25 years experience doing ground up restorations. Facts from northcoastautorestoration.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

## Services
- Classic, antique and muscle car restoration
- Custom builds
- Modern drivetrain conversions
- Muscle car customization
- Interior and exterior restoration
- Welding and metal fabrication
- Body work and refinishing
- Classic appraisals
- Consignment
- Parts sourcing
